findings.title: Policy retrieval does not verify tenant ownership
findings.evidence: Handler returns repository.findById(req.params.id) without comparing tenantId to the token claim.
findings.technical_impact: Any authenticated user can read policies of other tenants.
findings.business_impact: Disclosure of customer PII across brokers; regulatory exposure.
findings.recommended_solution: Scope the query by the tenant from the verified token and return 404 when not found.
findings.alternative_solutions: Central policy middleware or database row-level security.

recommendations.title: Enforce tenant-scoped data access
recommendations.acceptance_criteria: 100% of object-by-ID operations scope queries by tenant; cross-tenant regression tests pass in CI.
